summary: A sponsor finds a member in the other chamber who can carry the companion bill.
realLife: House members interviewed by Roll Call described enlisting Senate partners, including a committee chairman, to move legislation to enactment.
inGame: needs: companion bill identifiers linked across chambers and a sponsor in each.

turns.what: The other chamber's member declines to introduce a companion.
turns.pulledBy: The proposed text conflicts with a position the member has taken.
turns.writesBack: The first sponsor still has a bill in only one chamber.

turns.what: The second sponsor introduces a narrower companion.
turns.pulledBy: Only one section has enough support in the second chamber.
turns.writesBack: The companion texts differ at introduction.
